{{Infobox character|name=Wren Blackthorn|image=Portrait wren.jpg|house=[[House Blackthorn]]|role=Elder heir|age=~29|kin=[[Alder Blackthorn]] (father), [[Corin Blackthorn]] (brother)|words=We see the winter in the summer.}}
'''Wren Blackthorn''' is the elder heir of [[House Blackthorn]] — the sharp mind without the caution. As a child she beat her father at games by forcing tempo, not by out-thinking him; he called it a weakness she would grow out of. She never did.

Short, dry, razor-certain, she finishes other people's sentences and asks questions she already knows the answers to. She cannot leave a pattern unfinished: she aligns the game pieces on other people's boards, squares stacked papers, completes what someone else left half-done. The house reads it as tidiness.

{{Quote|Father would have weighed this for three weeks. We have three days.|Wren Blackthorn}}

She studied in the Defeat Library under the archivist [[Halden]], who taught her to read losses — before he stopped writing, and disappeared.
